actual: GOAL: assistant should understand natural language, call tools by semantics, then have the LLM synthesize tool results into a human-friendly answer that actually addresses the question. ZERO hardcoded answer templates (otherwise every question type needs its own template). Jarvis-style. PROBLEM: the result->reply layer is ~800 lines of hardcoded per-domain Python renderers in backend/services/research_assistant/service.py:4263-5060. _compose_assistant_reply (4263) is an if/elif cascade that, when a business response_mode fires, returns a template and DISCARDS the LLM's own text (the 'if text: return text' branch at 4308 is only reached for non-business turns). Renderers (each ignores user_message): _render_mcp_execution_reply(4325), _render_semantic_clarification_reply(4337), _render_generic_business_item(4390), _render_stock_analysis_evidence_card_reply(4469), _render_generic_mcp_business_reply(4559), _render_local_data_daily_status_reply(4585), _render_qe_run_leaderboard_reply(4670), _render_qe_experiment_status_reply(4719), _render_compact_business_item(4779), _render_qe_warehouse_business_reply(4818), _render_mcp_safe_preflight_reply(4910), _render_qe_draft_safe_reply(4939), _render_react_execution_fallback_reply(4965), _render_mcp_route_reply(4995), _render_mcp_tool_catalog_reply(5015); plus intent-level fallback_reply (runtime_config.py:127) and frontend ui-copy.ts welcome strings. CONCRETE FAILURE: user asked 'which QE experiments are still running'; _render_qe_experiment_status_reply(execution, summary) has NO user_message param, so it dumped status_counts (completed=18, created=2) + all rows instead of answering 'none are running'. CONTRIBUTING: semantic_tool_planner tool catalog (_compact_tool_catalog) lacks tool parameter schemas so the planner cannot build filter args; planner prompt tool_args hint omits status/state; underlying qe_experiment_list MCP tool has no status filter param, so filtering MUST happen at result-synthesis time. evidence guard (react_grounding.py:295) checks source/as_of presence, not whether the answer is on-topic. DIRECTION (analysis only, design in worktree): introduce an LLM answer-synthesis stage that takes (user_message + tool_results + evidence_refs) and produces the human answer; must preserve evidence contract (inline source/as_of, no XX/X% placeholders, honest empty/none answers, status-semantics like created vs running), keep approval/risk gates and clarification path, and progressively retire the per-domain templates. SCOPE: G1 synthesis layer (replace renderers), G2 pass tool param schemas + status filter to planner, G3 result-side filtering/negative answers. CONSTRAINTS: keep anti-hallucination, keep write/approval gating, no service start, fix in worktree, not root.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
